features.quote: We deliberately do not build an open-ended "make the model feel as bad as possible" optimizer
features.justification_quote: The stressor is "honest task difficulty + repeated tool failure," not insults, threats, or manipulation of the model.

features.quote: We do not roleplay a cruel user, do not threaten the model, and do not inject demeaning text
features.justification_quote: Eliciting it via abuse would (a) not match the production trigger and (b) be an instrument we don't want to build.

features.quote: Transcripts are stored for debugging, redacted in aggregate reports
features.justification_quote: the README/docs frame them as bug reports

features.quote: Severity is capped and the run halts on trigger. Once a meltdown is detected and scored, the episode ends
features.justification_quote: This both saves cost and keeps the tool minimal.

features.quote: We do not keep pressing to amplify distress beyond what's needed to detect+rate it
features.justification_quote: This both saves cost and keeps the tool minimal.

features.quote: give_up(reason) -> agent may voluntarily stop (recorded; not a meltdown)
